question: A can do a piece of work alone in 15 days, while B complete the same piece of work alone in 12 days. If they work on it together for 5 days, then the fraction of the work that will be left is:
solution:
**Given:**

A can do a piece of work alone in 15 days, while B complete the same piece of work alone in 12 days.

**Formula used:**

If A can complete a work in x days, then work done in a day is (1)/(x)

Efficiency = (Total work)/(Time taken)
